mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS active_employee_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM archive_document d JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id AND ar.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id WHERE d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS archive_document_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS ocr_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id WHERE b.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS ocr_succeeded_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id WHERE b.status = 'FAILED' AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS ocr_failed_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FROM archive_version v JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id LEFT JOIN ocr_binding b ON b.version_id = v.id WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (v.status = 'DRAFT' OR b.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')) ) AS pending_review_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM employee e JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.employee_id = e.id AND ar.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN archive_document d ON d.archive_record_id = ar.id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN archive_version v ON v.document_id = d.id AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS complete_employee_count
